defaults.headline: Made by hand, one batch at a time

content.text: We started with one oven and a borrowed table. Twelve years later we still shape every loaf by hand, and still know most of our neighbours by name.

photoLarge.alt: A smiling baker in a hairnet sliding bread from a brick oven

photoSide.alt: Two rustic sourdough loaves dusted with flour beside wheat stalks

photoSmall.alt: A golden croissant being dusted with sugar on a dark slate
